source.name: Forza Parma - Sponsor, Parma 12° con Prometeon: 1,5 milioni a stagione
source.quote: grazie all'accordo con Prometeon che vale circa 1,5 milioni di euro a stagione
source.note: 'The deal with Prometeon is worth around 1.5 million euros per season' (Italian). Forza Parma relays Calcio e Finanza's Serie A main-sponsor revenue ranking.

note: Main shirt sponsor since August 2022: the club (2023-08-10) says the Prometeon brand 'has been on Parma's jersey since August last year', and its CEO (2024-07-12) says Prometeon 'decided to support Parma Calcio in the summer of 2022'. No end date published; still main sponsor in 2026/27 per the club's kit-launch press release.
